## Discover High-MRR Paid Skool Communities & Enrich Creator Instagram/YouTube/LinkedIn Leads
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Skool Community & Creator Leads Scraper: Estimated MRR, Pricing & Socials](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-community-creator-leads-scraper)

Discover Skool communities by keyword, calculate estimated Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR = members × monthly subscription price), and extract the founder's Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and personal website.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [Skool Paid Community MRR & Pricing Calculator Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-paid-community-mrr-revenue-calculator-scraper)
- [Skool Creator Instagram, YouTube & Social Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-creator-instagram-youtube-email-leads-scraper)
- [Skool High-Commission Affiliate Communities Finder](https://apify.com/storeintel/skool-affiliate-program-high-ticket-courses-finder)
